strings.name: Judea Pearl
strings.summary: After electrical-engineering studies in Israel, Pearl moved to the US, researched memory devices and turned to AI at UCLA. His Bayesian networks, probabilistic reasoning and structural causal models connect observation, intervention and counterfactual questions. He received the 2011 Turing Award, popularized causal thinking and supported interfaith dialogue after his son Daniel’s murder.
